_help: Edit this file, then restart. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_api_key_help: Your CTA key lives in the .env file next to this one (CTA_API_KEY=...), which .gitignore keeps out of git.
_routes_help: Bus route numbers as strings, e.g. ["146", "151"]. Stops near home and work are found automatically.
_places_help: Home and work (HOME_LABEL/HOME_LAT/HOME_LON, WORK_LABEL/WORK_LAT/WORK_LON) are also kept in .env so they stay out of git.
_timing_help: Minutes added before the walk (elevator, lobby) and after it (walk into the building, elevator up).
_stops_help: Only stops within this many meters of home/work are considered. Force specific stops with stop_overrides, e.g. {"146": {"home": "1234", "work": "5678"}}; find ids with: python tracker.py --stops
_polling_help: CTA allows 100,000 calls/day per key; each refresh uses about 3. Outside active_hours the display dims and polls slowly.
